heroHeadline: EU Wildfire Growth Slows Further as Cernavodă Restart Assessment Waits for September 15
heroSubtitle: EFFIS put the EU's cumulative 2026 wildfire total at 659,419 hectares as of 13 September, growing just ~1,092 hectares over three days — the slowest multi-day pace of the season — as fire danger eased broadly, though extreme conditions persist in pockets of the western Balkans, southern Italy and Sicily. Romania's Energy Command has pushed its next Cernavodă assessment to after 15 September, with officials still targeting a restart toward the end of the month as Danube levels remain insufficient. No new wildfire outbreaks, fatalities or evacuations have been confirmed across Spain, France, Italy, Portugal, Greece or Romania since early September.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
